title: Filter results with custom widget?
body:
Not a bug just a question,

I'm trying to figure out a way i can pro-grammatically filter products in the hits component. is this possible using instantsearch.js ?

comments.body:
I tried this solution with the custom widget, and it worked out, 

but root categories become unsearchable in the instantsearch hierarchialMenu widget whenever toggleRefinement is called

is there a proper way to clear active filters so I can preserve hierarchalMenu?

Thanks

I think this is because the custom widget I made to filter items is still active even though i added another widget to clear all filters.

Is there a way to actually delete widgets?
Can you submit a jsfiddle where we can see what you are trying to do? All coding issues are easier to solve when live. Thanks
